entities.summary: Ibn Sahl was a Persian mathematician and physicist of the Islamic Golden Age, associated with the Buyid court of Baghdad. Despite attempts by professionals in the field of onomastics, neither his country of origin nor his religious allegiance could be parsed. Ibn Sahl was a logicians & mathematicians (940 CE–1000).
